meta.title: Household material situation
meta.question: How do Poles rate their household's material situation?
meta.measure: Average rating of one's household's material situation, from 0 (very bad) to 10 (very good)
meta.anchor: Pooled from every question on the household's present material and financial situation, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: How do you rate your (family's) [present] material conditions? (very bad ... very good, 7 points)
items.notes: CBOS, Jan 1990 - Jan 1992, 18 surveys; the 7-point predecessor of CBOS_MATCOND_5 (own or family's conditions). Never asked in the same survey as the 5-point item; linked through CBOS_LIVING_5 (Jan 1992), CBOS_INCMGMT_6 and EVS_SATFIN_10 (1990).

items.wording: Which best describes how your household manages its income? (enough for everything without special saving ... not enough even for the cheapest food and clothing)
items.notes: CBOS, Feb - Sep 1990, 5 surveys. Unequal steps between categories, placed linearly. Overlaps CBOS_MATCOND_7 in 1990.

items.wording: How satisfied are you with the financial situation of your household? (1 dissatisfied ... 10 satisfied)
items.notes: EVS 1990 (May - Jun) only; not asked of Poland in 1999, 2008 or 2017.

items.wording: Is your household's income, relative to its needs: much too low, somewhat too low, adequate, somewhat above, well above needs
items.notes: PGSS 1992-2010, 10 waves; household income relative to needs.

items.wording: How satisfied are you with your own financial situation: satisfied, more or less satisfied, dissatisfied
items.notes: PGSS 1992-2010, 10 waves; satisfaction with own financial situation (GSS satfin).

items.wording: How do you rate the present material conditions of your household? Are they: bad, rather bad, neither good nor bad, rather good, good
items.notes: CBOS, May 1992 - Dec 2017, 303 surveys (almost every month). Wordings Pan(i)/Pan[i]/P. all matched; some files label code 1 ' złe' with a leading space (allowed for).

items.wording: How do you assess your (household's) material situation: very good, rather good, average/acceptable, rather bad, very bad
items.notes: POLPAN 1988 and 1993 (the 1988 wave predates 1990). The 1998 variable with the same label (XR27) asks about change, and its labels fail the check, as intended. Panel survey (with refreshment samples): an ageing panel, not a fresh cross-section.

items.wording: How satisfied are you with the financial situation of your household? (1 dissatisfied ... 10 satisfied)
items.notes: WVS Poland 1989, 1997, 2005, 2012, 4 surveys (the 1989 survey predates 1990).

items.wording: How do you assess your household's current financial situation? (very good ... very bad)
items.notes: PGSW 1997-2023, 8 surveys.

items.wording: Are you on the whole satisfied with your income and financial situation? (very satisfied ... very dissatisfied)
items.notes: CBOS annual 'satisfaction with life' battery (December, and Apr 1999), 1999 - 2017, 19 surveys. Satisfaction with one's income rather than a rating of it; same direction. Dec 2003 labels code 1 'Bardzo zadowlony' (typo, allowed for).

items.wording: Household's economic situation now: bad, rather bad, neither good nor bad, rather good, good
items.notes: PGSW 2000 presidential study only.

items.wording: How adequate is your family's income: not really enough to survive on ... enough for a good standard of living
items.notes: PGSW 2001 only.

items.wording: How does your household get by on its income: with great difficulty, with difficulty, easily, very easily
items.notes: CCEB 2002.1 (Mar - Apr 2002) and 2004.1 (Feb - Mar 2004), 2 waves (2004 labels code 4 'very easy').

items.wording: How satisfied are you with your financial situation? (not at all ... very satisfied)
items.notes: CCEB 2002.1 (Mar - Apr 2002) only. ZA4240 (2003.5) has a label match but a filtered two-point question, which the label check rejects.

items.wording: Feeling about household's income nowadays: living comfortably, coping, difficult, very difficult on present income
items.notes: ESS rounds 1-11 (2002-2023), 11 surveys. Round 10 was self-completion (MODE_SPLITS applies).

items.wording: How would you judge the current situation of your (personal) financial situation? (very good ... very bad)
items.notes: EB 63.4 (May 2005), 65.2 (Mar 2006), 67.2 (Apr 2007), 3 waves. Polish questionnaire: 'Pana(i) sytuacja materialna' (your own material situation), not the household's, hence a separate item from EB_FINSIT_HH.

items.wording: How satisfied are you with your standard of living? (very ... not at all satisfied)
items.notes: PGSW 2005 only.

items.wording: Now thinking about your personal economic situation, how would you describe it: very good, somewhat good, somewhat bad, very bad
items.notes: Pew, asked of Poland in spring 2008, 2009, 2012 and 2013 (4 surveys). The label also matches in 2007, 2015, 2016 and 2017, where Poland was not asked (no positions).

items.wording: How would you judge the current situation of the financial situation of your household? (very good ... very bad)
items.notes: EB, Oct 2008 (ZA4819) - Mar 2026 (ZA9144), 41 waves. Up to ZA5928 (May 2014) several files carry a second, identically labelled copy for the Turkish Cypriot community (the 'b' variable, inapplicable in Poland); the collector takes the first match, which is the right ('a') one; the regex excludes the numbered QA..B copies.

items.wording: How do you assess the present overall financial situation of your household: good, partly good partly bad, bad
items.notes: SWPS omnibus 2020 only; 3-point.

items.wording: How do you assess your own (your family's) material situation: I am doing very well ... very badly, I am in a difficult situation
items.notes: SWPS omnibus 2020 only.

items.wording: As SINGLE_INCMGMT_BDCS (6 points)
items.notes: SWPS COVID tracker wave 9 (2020) only; code 7 = prefer not to say.

items.wording: As CBOS_MATCOND_5, in the CBOS democracy survey
items.notes: CBOS democracy survey = CBOS APiW of 8-18 Apr 2021, mixed mode (CAPI 535, CATI 435, CAWI 161). The label is cut at 80 characters in the Stata file.

items.wording: Feeling about household's income nowadays: living comfortably, coping, difficult, very difficult on present income
items.notes: ESS round 10 (2021-22): self-completion by web and paper in Poland, where every other round was face to face, so a question of its own.

items.wording: Living very comfortably / rather comfortably / with some difficulties / with a lot of difficulties on your present income
items.notes: EB 98.1 Parlemeter, Oct 2022, one wave; same idea as ESS_HINCFEL.

items.wording: As SINGLE_INCMGMT_BDCS (6 points)
items.notes: FNW SWPS surveys May 2025, Dec 2025, May 2026 (3 waves; m6/M6). Not the April 2026 presurvey, whose M6 is a vote question with another label.

items.wording: How do you assess your household's current material situation: good, rather good, neither, rather bad, bad
items.notes: PGSW 2025 only; CBOS-style scale (good ... bad, no 'very').

items.wording: Which best describes how your household manages its income? (enough for everything and we save ... not enough even for the cheapest food), 6 points
items.notes: BDCS survey, Poland (online Ariadna panel, Dec 2025), only. Same 6-category question as CBOS/Diagnoza's later version; unequal steps placed linearly. labels.csv truncates the value labels; checked in the file.
